result.brief: 提出流式世界动作模型 StreamingWAM，用分块阶梯流匹配、前缀 rollout 与稠密视频历史记忆实现跨块连续、低延迟的机器人动作预测。
result.reason: Builds on pretrained video-generation world models for robot control with chunk-wise streaming diffusion and video-history memory; main contribution is policy/control, so secondary application direction.
